proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A H B C _ h1 h2 h3 w hw
  rw [direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right ℝ (show B ∈ ({H, B, C} : Set P) by simp)] at hw
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact h3
    · simp
    · change inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) (y -ᵥ B) = 0
      have : A -ᵥ H = (A -ᵥ B) - (H -ᵥ B) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right A H B).symm
      rw [this, inner_sub_left, h1, h2, sub_zero]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [inner_add_right, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [real_inner_smul_right, hx, mul_zero]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A H B C : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({H, B, C} : Set P) → inner ℝ (A -ᵥ B) (C -ᵥ B) = 0 → inner ℝ (H -ᵥ B) (C -ᵥ B) = 0 → inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) (H -ᵥ B) = 0 → ∀ w ∈ (affineSpan ℝ ({H, B, C} : Set P)).direction, inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) w = 0
